name: Close Holiday Calendar
description: The group's holidays for one calendar year (konsol#509). Deadlines count a day as a working day only in a year that has a calendar here.

fields.label: Year
fields.description: The calendar year, for example 2027. One calendar per year.

fields.label: No Holidays This Year
fields.description: Tick to declare that this year has no holidays. Leave unticked and list the dates below otherwise. A year with neither is refused, so a year nobody filled in cannot pass for one with no holidays.

fields.label: Holidays
fields.description: Days in this year that are not counted as working days, group-wide. Each date may appear once.
